content: lan-mouse (Rust, Wayland-native) explicitly targets replacing Synergy/input-leap/deskflow for Wayland; uses per-compositor backends (wlroots virtual-keyboard/pointer protocols vs KDE's non-third-party-exposed kde-fake-input) so support is inconsistent across compositors (issues #187 labwc, #166 Hyprland show input-capture-portal backend unavailable errors). Clipboard sync and encryption are roadmap items, not yet shipped as of the versions reviewed — confirms clipboard is nontrivial even for a Wayland-native competitor.
